messages:
Maya: Heads up — Q4 capacity roadmap draft ready for review. Proposal: two procurement waves + a small reserved commit for an APAC pilot. Need a decision by EOD Friday so we can lock POs and vendor slots.
Jordan: Can you drop the high-level numbers? reserved vs spot split, target utilization, and which regions in each wave?
Maya: Draft below. Wave 1 (early Sep): NA + EU reserved 60 GPUs total. Wave 2 (mid-Oct): APAC pilot reserved 40 GPUs. Remaining capacity on spot. Target fleet util: 75% steady-state. Fallback: auto-burst to spot pools.
Samir: Risk callout: Vendor lead times for H100 are 12-18 weeks depending on SKU. If we plan mid-Oct order for APAC, delivery could slip into Q1. Recommend placing a smaller early commit for APAC (20 GPUs) to shorten lead risk.
Tiago: Quick cost delta (ballpark):
```
# monthly cost estimate (USD)
reserved_100g = 60 * 1200  # committed price baseline
reserved_40g = 40 * 1250
spot_pool = 200 * 450
monthly_reserved = reserved_100g + reserved_40g
monthly_spot = spot_pool
delta = monthly_reserved - monthly_spot
```
Not perfect but shows reserved bump vs spot; we should model token-unit cost impact before sign-off.
Lee: Customer ask: Customer-42 requires SG-region dedicated pool with p95 latency SLA by Nov 15. That hard date would require APAC capacity in late Oct for soak + perf testing.
Priya: Proposed launch gates for any region add: 1) Dedicated pool provisioned + infra tests green 2) Perf tests: p95 < 90ms (chat) or < 120ms (gen) 3) Routing & fallback tested (regional→global) 4) KMS + audit log enabled 5) Cost monitoring dashboard live 6) Sign-off from Sales/Customer Success.
Maya: Updated allocation suggestion after Samir: Wave 1 (Sep): NA/EU reserved 60 (H100-heavy). Wave 2a (early Oct): APAC small commit 20 (to secure lead time). Wave 2b (mid-Oct): top-up 20 once lead times confirmed. Util target remains 75%.
Jordan: Who owns the PO and vendor negotiation? Finance sign-off path?
Maya: Jordan — can you own the PO + cost justification to Finance? Samir will validate lead times with Vendor Ops.
Samir: I'll ping vendor-ops and request confirmed ETA by tomorrow. Also recommend SKU split: H100: 80%, A100: 20% for NA/EU to balance throughput vs cost.
Tiago: Slight tweak: if we keep 20% A100 we save ~12% on committed spend and lose ~6% perf on some workloads — tradeoff looks acceptable for non-latency-critical customers.
deploy-bot: procurement-bot created task #1973456799: "Create Q4 capacity PO draft" assigned to @Jordan.
Priya: Also add launch criteria checklist to the PRD and link it to the rollout runbook. We need canary routing + automatic fallback to hosted API.
Lee: I'll confirm Customer-42 commitment (they need an SLA/contract amendment). If they sign, that'll justify moving the mid-Oct top-up earlier.
Maya: Action list: - Maya: consolidate this thread into a short decision doc by tomorrow. - Jordan: draft PO + spreadsheet for Finance. - Samir: confirm lead times & SKU availability with Vendor Ops. - Tiago: run token-cost model and upload numbers. - Lee: lock customer commitment date. - Priya: add launch gates to PRD + runbook.
Jordan: I'll add numbers into the capacity sheet: https://go/sheets/q4-capacity-draft (placeholder). Sync Wed 09:00 PT to finalize.
Maya: :thumbsup: Wed 09:00 PT works. If vendor ops confirm longer lead times, we will shift to early commit for APAC.
Samir: Noted. Will report back with vendor ETA and any MOQ constraints.
Tiago: I'll drop a quick cost delta table into the sheet by EOD.
Priya: Also flagging compliance: APAC customers may require specific export docs. Lee, check legal for SG-specific rules.
Lee: On it. Legal pinged.
Maya: Thanks all — aim is to have an actionable PO + vendor confirmation by Friday.
Jordan: Ack.
